scaling.note: ROOM 16'S DEPTH, FROM THE MAN THE MASTER PAINTED: about 370 tall with his feet at source y 790, which is 467 at y 783 in this plate's frame; along Room 5's slope (0.69 a row) that is 448 at the band's far edge and 519 at its near. Ozymandia stands behind the table at 440 (tools/art/room16-ozymandia.py).

entrances.note: In by the flap, at left: the Lane leads here.

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees (ruling 32), smallest first. THE CURTAIN is its left fall, beside her, so a LOOK at her is not the curtain's; THE TENT WALLS the painted canvas between the rod and the chart; THE GROUND the strip of bare earth behind the walk band; THE SECOND ROD the long box under the table. Errata 237 (doc 111, B, the séance): while the séance is on (T_SEANCE_ON), THE SÉANCE TABLE over her table and THE LAMP over the hanging lantern take their places (MADAME OZYMANDIA'S TABLE and THE LANTERN, RED are gated off), MADAME OZYMANDIA, PRESIDING is over her own figure, THE SITTERS round the table and MR. FRAME, AT THE TABLE at its front. PENDING ART: the séance table, its sitters, Frame and the turned-down lamp are act3-seance's to draw (reference/act3-seance/brief.md); until they are cut in, these rects stand over the plate's own table and lantern and over empty floor, and are redrawn when the cut-outs land.

THE FLAP TO OUTSIDE.note: Errata 161 (errata 43's three streets): the tent stands in a lot off the Lane.

lamps.note: The red lantern hung centre. A slow, low breath (invariant 9).

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. Every object here is looked at on a bare click.

Thad's walk band is in front of everything, so his bands are plane 0.

planes.note: The crystal ball, the cash box and the tea pot, by box and by colour off the plate (tools/art/room16-ozymandia.py). Assigned to Ozymandia by her ambient record's clipPlane, not by any walk box.

onEnterSetWhenNote: Errata 237 (doc 111, B): the séance is on from the evening after Fanshawe's offer (E0b, which makes ACT 3) until Mott has spoken (T_MOTT_SPOKE). Set on the way in here and in the Lane, the only way here; a player who never sat in finds it over in Act IV.

verbRules.note: Errata 237: under the table and not yet spoken -- he took SEA_E1's way out (doc 04's universal exit, "available at every node") and is still under the cloth -- USE THE SÉANCE TABLE opens SEA_E1 again with nothing said, so the séance can always be finished.
